entries.zh: 切中事理、说得在理（acertar con la razón，即道理对得上）
entries.en: to hit on the right reason; to reason correctly

entries.zh: 切合时机、恰中时节（中节）
entries.en: to hit the right moment or occasion

entries.zh: 射中靶心、正中目标（中的）
entries.en: to hit the target, hit the mark

entries.zh: 科考各经之魁首、乡试经元（经魁：明制乡试分经取士的第一名）
entries.en: top placer (first) in one of the classics in the civil examination

entries.zh: 开头顺遂、发端得利的吉兆（好兆头）
entries.en: a good omen, good luck at the start; auspicious beginning
entries.notes: 汉字「威實」与西语释义字面不直接互证，主要依据西语 'buen acierto al principio, buen aguero' 释义，故降 medium。

entries.zh: 舀水、打水，指船上排出舱内积水（achicar el agua en el navío）
entries.en: to bail out water, as in a ship
to make bright, to shine, to light up

entries.zh: 散开、消散（〔疑〕字或为「霰/散」，谓云雾散而天晴）
entries.en: to clear up, disperse (of clouds or mist)
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注〔疑:霰/散〕，字面依赖推断，依音写 sоẫ / zān 与 aclarar 释义作「散」。

entries.zh: 明白、通晓；终于明朗（会明）
entries.en: to understand clearly; to become clear at last

entries.zh: 随时制宜、随宜安顿自己（随时，就时而处）
entries.en: to adapt oneself to circumstances, suit the time

entries.zh: 妇人随夫而安于贱位（夫贱则随贱，类「嫁鸡随鸡」之义）
entries.en: the wife conforms to her husband's lowly station

entries.zh: 妇人随夫而居贵位（夫贵则随贵）
entries.en: the wife conforms to her husband's honored station

entries.zh: 惜福、安于本分而自爱其境遇（惜福）
entries.en: to cherish one's lot, be content with one's station

entries.zh: 辅佐、助理（职事或劳作中相帮；辅）
entries.en: to assist, to aid (in office or work)

entries.zh: 陪位、随侍（在官职或名分上相陪；陪）
entries.en: to accompany in office or dignity, attend as peer

entries.zh: 陪点：在官职位分上作陪衬、列名随班
entries.en: to attend in office or dignity as attendant/companion in rank
entries.notes: 「陪點」为成词组合，具体官制用法依西语 'acompañar en el oficio o dignidad' 释义推断，故 medium。
